away.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs (3-2-1, 7 points) are coming off a 6-3 win over the Colorado Avalanche, marking their first road win of the season. Sergei Bobrovsky earned his first victory as a Maple Leaf, making 30 saves. The team scored a season-high six goals and showed improved special teams, going 2-for-4 on the power play and 5-for-5 on the penalty kill.

home.summary: The Utah Mammoth (4-2-0) are returning home after a 4-1 win over the Buffalo Sabres to wrap up a five-game road trip. They are tied for fifth in the NHL in goals per game (3.67) and lead the league in power play efficiency at 40 percent. Forward Nick Schmaltz is tied for the league lead with six goals and scored his fourth power-play goal of the season in the Sabres win.
